verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or another MCP client to check their calendar, find open times, book meetings, and manage scheduling links from a chat. That covers availability, bookings, and event types. A documented REST surface backs this up, with endpoints for slots, creating, listing and cancelling events, and updating links, all using OAuth or personal access tokens. missing for 10: detailed MCP server docs (tool list, setup, auth flow beyond a single mention), independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP integration works as described.
